prompt.project_info: Photorealistic romantic underwater couple portrait in clear turquoise ocean water.
prompt.main_subject: Two approved adults using the attached couple reference: woman and man in close side profile sharing a gentle kiss, eyes closed, natural hair floating with water movement; woman in dark swimwear and man with bare upper body as shown in the reference.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical close-up with faces sharp and bodies partially visible, turquoise water, bubbles, sun rays from surface, floating hair, water distortion and soft particles.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Natural top-down underwater sunlight, subtle caustics on skin, soft low contrast, cool blue-green underwater shift, intimate but non-explicit romantic atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: 35mm underwater-lens look, f/2.8, moderate shallow depth of field, realistic buoyancy and water distortion, subtle underwater film grain, sharp faces and soft background fade.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a vertical photorealistic underwater couple portrait using the attached approved-adult couple reference: two adults in close side profile sharing a gentle kiss with eyes closed, woman in dark swimwear and man with bare upper body, floating hair, natural bubbles, turquoise clear ocean, top-down sunlight rays, realistic caustics and water distortion, cool blue-green cinematic realism.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized pose, nudity, minors, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, distorted anatomy, extra limbs, malformed faces, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, watermark, logo overlay
